summary: MCP 2.0 removes mcp.server.fastmcp and the unchanged adapter produces 16 type-checking errors; MCP remains constrained to 1.x until a typed migration passes all gates.
Official MCP Python SDK 2.1.1 exports mcp.server.MCPServer as the documented typed replacement and publishes a stable public API policy.

MCP 2 construction, six-tool registration and invocation tests pass; full local quality passes 27 of 27 gates including zero-error BasedPyright. No type suppressions, relaxed settings or compatibility shim were introduced.
The default integration environment now skips on the real optional mcp.server module rather than the repository mcp namespace directory; the MCP environment still executes all seven adapter tests.
